question: Do sustained winners differ from temporary viral products in their first 2 observed months?
rationale: Durable demand should show steadier early growth and broader channel mix than spikes
data_fields: revenue, units, ASP, channel revenues, launch_date, rank
independent_vars: entry rank, MoM growth months 1-2, video/live/showcase share, ASP, age at entry, commission
comparison: C vs A, also B vs D
method: distribution comparison + logistic regression with category and entry-month fixed effects
limitations: groups use future months by construction: descriptive only, not predictive
support_criteria: standardised difference >=0.2 and consistent sign in >=2/3 of entry-month cohorts

question: Does computed MoM revenue growth at m predict Retain (T1) at m+1 beyond current rank?
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
method: Holm-adjusted month-block bootstrap; support = lift interval excludes 0 and holds in >=2/3 of eval months
limitations: MoM growth needs m-1 observed (product in a list)
support_criteria: precision@50 lift over B1 with interval > 0

question: Is Kalodata's undocumented momentum field predictive beyond computed MoM growth?
rationale: It may encode a shorter, more recent window
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
method: Holm-adjusted month-block bootstrap; support = lift interval excludes 0 and holds in >=2/3 of eval months
limitations: meaning undocumented (Phase A §4)
support_criteria: incremental lift over B3 with interval > 0

question: Does growth acceleration (change in MoM growth) add to growth level?
rationale: Accelerating products may be earlier in their curve
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
method: Holm-adjusted month-block bootstrap; support = lift interval excludes 0 and holds in >=2/3 of eval months
limitations: needs 3 consecutive observed months

question: Do very high growth rates (top 5%) predict decline (non-linear reversal)?
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
method: quantile analysis + isotonic fit
limitations: censoring of T5

question: Are younger products (launch_date) more likely to climb than older at the same rank?
rationale: New products are earlier in the lifecycle
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
method: logistic with rank splines + category FE
confounders: survivorship (old products in top-500 are already proven)
limitations: launch_date = Kalodata first-seen date
support_criteria: age coefficient interval excludes 0, sign stable

question: Can riser-list products (outside top-500) be ranked to predict break-in (T6)?
population: riser-list products at m not in top-500
method: Holm-adjusted month-block bootstrap; support = lift interval excludes 0 and holds in >=2/3 of eval months
confounders: riser list selected by undocumented field
limitations: ~95% of top-500 entrants were in no list the month before (Phase A §6)
support_criteria: precision@50 lift > 0; report coverage of all entrants

question: Do price level and price changes (ASP) relate to retention?
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
independent_vars: ASP rel. to category median, ASP change
method: Holm-adjusted month-block bootstrap; support = lift interval excludes 0 and holds in >=2/3 of eval months
limitations: ASP = revenue/units (blended across SKUs)

question: Do channel mixes (video vs live vs showcase share) predict retention?
rationale: Showcase/search demand may be more durable than video-driven spikes
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
method: Holm-adjusted month-block bootstrap; support = lift interval excludes 0 and holds in >=2/3 of eval months
limitations: channel attribution is Kalodata's

question: Does affiliate commission rate relate to climbing?
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
method: Holm-adjusted month-block bootstrap; support = lift interval excludes 0 and holds in >=2/3 of eval months
limitations: 33% of rows have commission 0 (meaning: no open plan or unknown)
testability: not testable historically (commission is a current value copied into past months; Phase A)

question: Are views and likes weak proxies for video revenue?
data_fields: video views, likes, shares, comments, revenue
method: Spearman within category-month, then pooled
limitations: lists are revenue-sorted: range-restricted

question: Do products backed by more creators/videos at m retain better (T1, T4)?
method: logistic with rank + category controls
limitations: n~1,000, ~3 per category-month

question: Is revenue concentration in one video a downside risk?
data_fields: video rank filtered by product (2026-09 only, 99 products)
method: descriptive
limitations: only one month, outcome not yet collected
testability: not testable yet (needs Oct-2026 outcomes or more product-video pulls)

question: Are paid-ad videos (ad flag, ROAS) associated with higher video revenue per view?
method: rank tests within category-month
limitations: ROAS is a Kalodata estimate, defined only for ads; AI flag unknown before 2026-06

question: Do creative features (hook, cuts, speech, demo) differ between winning and comparison videos?
method: views, creator size
confounders: small, possibly biased sample; tags by one LLM
limitations: consistent paired differences with FDR control

question: Do products in categories with growing top-500 revenue outperform those in stagnant ones?
data_fields: top-500 revenue by category-month (our own aggregate)
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
method: logistic with rank
limitations: top-500 sum is a proxy for category size (27-91% coverage)

question: Are fragmented categories (low top-3-shop share in top-500) easier to enter (more new entrants retained)?
independent_vars: top-3 shop share, HHI, distinct shops
method: category-month regression
limitations: 29 categories x 12 months only

question: Does a rising number of shops selling near-identical products precede falling ASP/retention?
method: panel regression
limitations: needs title clustering (no product family ids)

question: Do products whose shop holds many top-500 products retain better (shop strength)?
population: top-500 panel (DEFINITIONS_v1 §1), products ranked 101-500 at m unless stated
method: Holm-adjusted month-block bootstrap; support = lift interval excludes 0 and holds in >=2/3 of eval months

question: Established demand + low ad share of video revenue = opportunity?
limitations: video-product links exist only for 99 products in one month

question: Do review pain points (size/quality/'not as pictured') relate to retention?
method: descriptive only
limitations: n=24, insight dates 2025-07..2026-10 (stale)

question: Do annotated product attributes (demonstrability, novelty, problem severity) predict retention?
method: logistic with controls; inter-rater agreement first (kappa>=0.6)
limitations: needs annotation protocol; descriptions only for ~1,000 detail rows
testability: needs new annotation work (local, no API cost)

question: What share of high-scoring Kalodata products can be matched to CJ at a viable contribution margin?
rationale: Demand without sourcing is not an opportunity
method: descriptive
limitations: CJ prices are current only; DDU quotes
testability: testable after Phase C (needs CJ calls, free)

question: Does an advertising-suitability score predict our own ad results?
limitations: we have ~2-4 tested products; TikTok ad account closed 2026-10-31

question: Are some products frequently co-promoted (same creators) and bundle-able?
limitations: needs paid API pulls (creator/video filters)

question: Does knowing a product was in ranks 501-1,000 last month (niche deep pulls) improve niche retention prediction?
rationale: Climbing through the band signals building demand (Phase B §6)
method: walk-forward ablation, dP@20, month bootstrap
limitations: deep lists exist for 4 categories only
support_criteria: dP@20 CI excludes 0 and >0 in >=2/3 months

question: Can products in ranks 501-1,000 be ranked by their chance of entering the top 500 next month?
rationale: Early-warning zone below the visible list
independent_vars: band rank, revenue, growth, age, channels
method: walk-forward M1 within band; coverage of entrants
limitations: 4 categories
support_criteria: coverage >=30% and band P@20 >= 2x base rate

question: Does the shop being in the category's top-100 shop list improve niche retention prediction?
method: walk-forward ablation dP@20
limitations: shop lists cover top 100 shops only
support_criteria: dP@20 CI excludes 0 and >0 in >=2/3 months

question: Does the H-N2 band result (break-in from ranks 501-1,000) replicate in the 24 non-niche categories?
rationale: Out-of-sample replication: these categories' 501-1,000 lists have never been downloaded or analysed
data_fields: top_deep ranks, 24 non-niche L1 categories (to be pulled 2026-11-01)
independent_vars: identical feature set and code as H-N2 (phase_c_niche.py band section)
comparison: B1 revenue rank in band, random
method: walk-forward M1 within band; identical spec; no tuning
limitations: same months as before (months not untouched; categories are)
support_criteria: replicates if coverage >=30% AND band catP@20 >= 2x base AND M1-B1 dcatP@20 CI excludes 0

question: Do discovery strategies (emerging, proven, underexploited, creative-driven) select products with different durable-demand (T4) rates than the plain retention model?
method: walk-forward M1 within eligible pool; month-block bootstrap; Holm across 4
limitations: months not untouched; eligible pools vary in size
support_criteria: CI of P@20 difference vs F excludes 0 and same sign in >=3/4 months, Holm-adjusted

question: Do break-in picks from ranks 501-1,000 last (enter the top 500 and stay 3 months) more often than a revenue rule picks them?
rationale: Owner wants not-yet-validated opportunities; entering is only useful if demand then holds
population: band products at m (all categories with band data)
comparison: B1 revenue vs cutoff, base rate
method: walk-forward logit, within-category P@20, month-block bootstrap
limitations: months used in Phase C (exploratory)
support_criteria: hold3 catP@20 >= 2x base AND model-B1 CI excludes 0 AND ahead in >=4/5 months
